title: Whips (presentation) and the autoswing rule (Feral Claws family)
player_outcome: The whip is a visible tapered lash that coils back and cracks with a snap and sparks at the tip. Whips need a Feral Claws-type accessory to auto-swing, as in Terraria 1.4.4.
design: New game/Entities/WhipRenderer.cs: for each active lash, a 6-sided tapered tube (width 0.03 → 0.008) along WhipGeometry.Points, evaluated at smooth render time. Colour from the item (whip params colour). Hide the held whip model while lashing and draw a handle cylinder at the hand socket.
Crack moment (t 0.55–0.6): EffectKit Sparks at the tip plus Sfx 'whip_crack'. Swing-up whoosh 'whip_swing' at the start.
StatIds.Autoswing ('autoswing'), registered in the Known set.
ItemUseSystem repeat rule: whips repeat only when Autoswing > 0. Melee keeps 1.4.4 always-autoswing.

Data: feral_claws and its upgrades present in data (power_glove, mechanical_glove, fire_gauntlet, berserkers_glove if they exist) gain {stat: autoswing, add: 1}; descriptions follow Terraria ('Enables auto swing for melee weapons and whips').
ContentValidator.Items: warn on autoReuse set on melee swing items (dead data).
files_add: game/Entities/WhipRenderer.cs — lash tube rendering and crack effects
data_changes: data/items/equipment.json feral_claws (+ existing upgrades): add equipEffect {type: stat, stat: autoswing, add: 1}; update descriptions
tests: WhipTests (extend): with feral_claws equipped, holding repeats the whip
